Riding light (first light to last light, Vancouver): Thu, Nov 19 7:53am to 6:02pm; Fri, Nov 20 7:55am to 6:01pm; Sat, Nov 21 7:56am to 6pm. Hours outside that are dark and not listed; never suggest riding then.

Guillermo's own take for Thu, Nov 19 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Porteau day. The outflow is holding: Pam Rocks read NNE 24 at 5am, right on the page, and Pemberton still sits 5 hPa above Vancouver.

Go Porteau from first light, about 8am, to 10:30. Expect around 20 at the beach, a bit under Pam Rocks, with good waves. The tide floods toward 14.4ft at 2pm, so the swell may soften late.

Check before driving: Pam Rocks N 22+ at 8am. If it's fading, try Jericho after 9:30am once the tide passes 10ft, but only if the buoy holds NW or W 12+.
